description: Fetch observations from a LINDAS statistical cube as flat rows keyed by dimension labels (IRI values replaced by their human labels; numbers as numbers). Optional filters map a dimension (label, IRI or IRI local name) to one value or a list of values (label, literal such as a year, or IRI), matching is exact and case-insensitive; get valid values from describe_data_cube. Returns columns (with role and unit), rows and row_count. limit default 100, max 1000 (large results are trimmed to fit 50 KB). Examples: {cube: 'https://energy.ld.admin.ch/elcom/electricityprice', filters: {'Period': '2025', 'Category': 'H4'}, limit: 50}, {cube: '<IRI>', filters: {'Canton': ['Zürich', 'Bern']}}.

filters.description: {dimension label/IRI: value label/IRI or array of them}. Max 10 filters.

include_iris.description: Also return the raw IRI of each IRI-valued cell as '<column> IRI'

include_sparql.description: Return the generated SPARQL (to adapt with query_lindas)

offset.description: Skip observations for paging (stable order; max 10000; use filters to reach deeper data)

name: query_data_cube
title: Query observations from a LINDAS data cube
